The '''Defender sporting blaster pistol''' was made by the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]]. The DDC Defender was a short range and low-powered weapon, meant for civilian self-defense and small-game [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]]. It was also a popular weapon for use in [[honor duel]]s among the nobility.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==Description==
Compared to other blasters the Defender used very little [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas, instead relying on its small power pack to provide most of the energy for each shot. This meant a number of limitations for the weapon: its low-powered shots had a short range and could only kill a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a direct hit; advanced components including enhanced galven circuitry, focusing coils and a galven ring in the emitter nozzle were needed to maintain each bolt's cohesion; and a power surge dampener and extended cooling coil sleeve were needed to protect its delicate components.<ref name="EGWT" />

However the weapon had a number of advantages which made it a top-selling model, especially as a socially-acceptable sidearm for aristocrats. Its slim design was easy to use and very lightweight; it also meant it could be more easily concealed, especially within hidden pockets. The Defender could be disassembled within a few minutes into three pieces, the grip, receiver, and barrel, for easy storage or concealment as innocuous items which could pass through most security scans or personal searches. This was done by typing a three-digit code in the access panel above the trigger,<ref name="BP" /> and the three parts (handle, receiver and barrel) could be reassembled in under ten seconds. In addition an internal computer automatically repaired minor malfunctions, while its power pack could be changed quickly and carried enough power for about 100 shots.<ref name="FF" /><ref name="EGWT" />

The blaster was able to be modified with higher capacity energy packs and had a range of compact muzzle options for easier concealment.<ref name="BP" />

==History==
[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] wielded such a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] against [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the boarding of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].<ref name="FF" /> Luke Skywalker carried this type of pistol at the [[Royal Award Ceremony|award ceremony]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWI 98">{{InsiderCite|98|Set Piece|Set Piece: Massassi Temple}}</ref> While on the mud-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Panna Prime]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] come under attack by a [[Panna dragon]], which began to [[Diet/Legends|devour]] the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter]]. Skywalker's Defender sporting blaster pistol had no effect on the beast, so Fett intervened and scared it off with his [[Amban phase-pulse blaster/Legends|Amban phase-pulse blaster]].<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Defender sporting blaster, first seen being wielded by Princess Leia in {{Film|IV}}, was based on the Soviet-made Margolin .22 MTs target pistol. The same model pistol was the basis for the shorter-barreled [[X-30 "Lancer" target blast pistol]] used by Leia in {{Film|VI}}.<ref name="SWI 59">{{InsiderCite|59|Set Piece|Set Piece: Rebel Alliance Briefing Room}}</ref>
